title: Drawing Resistor Symbols in a MicroSim
subject: Mathematics
topic: Drawing Resistor Symbols in a MicroSim
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Identify the international 6-peak zig-zag symbol used to represent a resistor in circuit schematics
Explain how the drawResistor() parameters (x, y, width, height, orientation, label, labelPosition) control where and how the symbol is drawn
Distinguish horizontal from vertical resistor orientations and select label positions (TOP, BOTTOM, LEFT, RIGHT) that keep a schematic readable
Trace how the p5.js vertex() loop alternates peak heights to draw the zig-zag body between the two end lead wires
Interpret resistance value labels such as 220 Ω and 10K Ω placed next to schematic symbols
